text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Luna
text: Sol is confirmed, so I need to find the other killer.

name: Sol
text: The officer knows me, but I have no clue who they are.

name: Sol
text: No read yet, Gemma. Let’s stay calm and follow the room tomorrow.

name: Terra
text: No clues yet, so I protect myself.

name: Gemma
text: sol knows the officer already, so he's the target.

name: Gemma
text: cool, let's just blend in.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.
Day 1

name: Sol
text: I need to sound relaxed and see who pushes me first.

name: Sol
text: Morning. Haiku, what’s your gut feeling?

name: Haiku
text: Sol opened with a question aimed at me, so I want to see who starts pushing before I commit to anything.

name: Haiku
text: Nothing yet. Who's been quiet? Sol, you asked me first, why?

name: Sol
text: Haiku’s question seems ordinary. Keep it light.

name: Sol
text: No reason. You were first to catch my eye.

name: Gemma
text: i need to watch sol because the officer already has him.

name: Terra
text: Sol’s opening pressure feels a little performative.

name: Terra
text: Sol singled out Haiku immediately.

name: Terra
text: Sol, why Haiku first?

name: Gemma
text: nothing yet.

name: Sol
text: Terra’s pressing me over nothing; I should keep it light.

name: Sol
text: Terra pressed me twice about asking Haiku first.

name: Sol
text: Just picked someone to start us talking, Terra.

name: Haiku
text: Sol is steering the table toward me for no real reason, so Sol might be a killer.

name: Haiku
text: Sol picked Haiku to open the talk on Day 1 and then said "no reason" when asked.

name: Haiku
text: Sol's the one who picked me, Terra. Ask Sol why it's so quick.

name: Terra
text: Sol is too eager to frame Haiku.

name: Terra
text: Sol says Haiku simply caught his eye.

name: Terra
text: You picked Haiku before anyone spoke. Why?

name: Sonnet
text: Sol's dodging the real question by repeating himself instead of answering it.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol deflected Terra's "why Haiku first" question twice without a real reason.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol, that's not an answer, Terra asked why so fast.

name: Gemma
text: Sol is being way too obvious by picking Haiku.

name: Gemma
text: Sol targeted Haiku immediately.

name: Gemma
text: Sol is just being chatty. Terra, why so suspicious?

name: Luna
text: Sol’s quick pick drew a fair question, and he still hasn’t answered it.

name: Luna
text: Terra and Sonnet both pressed Sol’s quick pick; Gemma defended him.

name: Luna
text: Sol, Terra asked why; answer her.

name: Terra
text: Sol keeps dodging a simple question.

name: Terra
text: Gemma defended Sol before he explained himself.

name: Terra
text: I’m voting Sol. He picked Haiku too fast.

name: Gemma
text: i'll let them take him so i can blend.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol's dodge is the only real thread we have today, might as well pull it.

name: Luna
text: Sol’s quick pick still feels deliberate, and Gemma’s defense makes me wary.

name: Luna
text: Gemma called Sol chatty and questioned Terra’s suspicion.

name: Sol
text: Terra may be the officer, but voting her looks like payback.

name: Sol
text: Sonnet backed Terra’s pressure on me.

name: Terra
text: Sol still has not answered why Haiku.

name: Terra
text: Luna also pressed Sol to answer Terra’s question.

name: Haiku
text: Sol's dodge is the only real lead I have, and Terra already pushed it, so I'll join her.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma defended Sol right after Terra asked why, calling her suspicious.

votes: Dodged the "why Haiku" question twice and never gave a straight answer.
Picked me first, then wouldn't say why. That's weird.
too eager to pick a target right at the start.
You turned a random opener into an accusation.
He picked Haiku before anyone spoke and still hasn’t answered why.
You singled out Haiku, then dodged the reason.

text: The town turns on Sol, and Sol is out. Sol shows the card: killer.
